defects.description: Monthly retraining only starts a training job and writes the artifact to S3. Nothing creates a model or endpoint config from it or updates the live endpoint, so the retrained model never reaches production. R8 mentions a deployment process, but the design has none.

The scoring path has no timeout, fallback or error-handling behaviour. If the SageMaker endpoint is slow or unavailable, checkout is blocked, which weakens the 99.9% target the design set itself. There are also no alarms on endpoint latency or errors, and no edges to CloudWatch from the endpoint or Lambda.

The training job launcher is shown reading training inputs from S3, but SageMaker reads the inputs itself. The Cognito authorizer suits end users, so machine-to-machine checkout clients may need a different auth choice. No KMS or CMK is specified, and no multi-instance or multi-AZ endpoint configuration is stated.

reviews.summary: A workable synchronous scoring path with managed training, but it never deploys retrained models and has no fallback or endpoint alarms.

defects.description: The EventBridge schedule is wired straight to a node that combines SageMaker training jobs and Model Registry. EventBridge targets SageMaker Pipelines rather than raw training jobs, so the trigger and deployment mechanism (for example a pipeline) is unspecified. There is no edge from training to CloudWatch for failed runs.

The 200 ms timeout and the multi-AZ instance count for the endpoint are not justified or specified. The rules-based fallback means some payments are approved without a model score, which should be an explicit business decision.

reviews.summary: Covers the full lifecycle: a timeout and fallback on the scoring path, KMS and PITR on the data, a registry-based deploy to a stable endpoint, and alarms.
